buildType: deterministic fixed-anchor augmentation of the exact device-verified Next Hour Provider Conversion bundles; not Rollup

feature.matchDiagnostics: Apple raw descriptions, QWeather raw event names/descriptions, normalized matcher keys, exact pair equality and unmatched Unicode fragments; script log only, bounded to 2 Apple events and 4 QWeather candidates
feature.genericWarningSuffixNormalization: Strip only a terminal generic warning marker in the type key; severity and exact issue time remain mandatory

validation.bundleSyntax: node --check passed for both request and response scripts

limitations: No real Fangshan Apple response binary or paired QWeather HTML was used; test strings are synthetic and cannot determine e0 actual type.

Bundle generation is fixed-anchor augmentation of hash-pinned device-verified bundles, not full Rollup source build; private @nsringo/weatherkit previously returned HTTP 401.
